title: MetNet-3: short-range neural forecasts in Google products
summary: The model forecasts precipitation, temperature, wind and dew point up to 24 hours ahead at 1–4 km resolution, learning from about 1,000 stations, and outperforms HRRR and ENS in several regions. It operates in Google Search and the app in the United States and 27 European countries, with precipitation forecasts up to 12 hours. Preprint, no numerical values in the text and one case study.

evidence.tested: MetNet-3 was benchmarked against HRRR and ENS over the contiguous US for forecasts up to 24 hours, scored with CRPS; a single January 2019 case study is also shown.
evidence.unknown: The post has no limitations section; it notes operational coverage limited to the contiguous US and parts of Europe, hyperlocal wind results depend on test-station input, and the case study is a single example.
evidence.ai_role: A neural model forecasts precipitation, temperature, wind and dew point up to 24 hours ahead, learning from about 1,000 stations.
